lines.t: What is all this sin to him?
Smoke that stings his children's eyes
We tear the hedge he planted round us
The Nazquiet flames begin to rise
He sees the wounds we call our freedom
He sees the chains we name our choice
He hears the words we never whisper
The silent storms without a voice
He does not grieve for lack of glory
He does not weep to God His name
He mourns the thoughts that turn against us
That cut our souls with hidden blame
What is all this sin to Him?
Is He not the victory?
He broke the grave, He crushed the night
He holds the dawn in perfect light
He is the first, He is the last
Unmoved by all our broken past
Our sins can't shake His sovereignty
But they are tearing us beneath
Is He not the victory?
Come wounded hearts and bow the knee
His law is not a cage of iron
It is a wall of living flame
To guard our hands from doing violence
To shield our minds from secret shame
Each word is meant to hedge our footsteps
And also search the inward man
To turn our fantasies from darkness
And break the lies in which they stand
His jealous fire is not for pride
No hunger for a larger crown
He burns because He sees His children
Nurturing thoughts that pull them down
So when conviction floods the heartbeat
be. He rises from unfailing love. He grieves the seeds that bruise us inward
and fights for us from realms above.
What is all this sin to Him? Is He not the victory?
His hands still bear the marks of love His call still reaches from above
We cannot add to all He is We cannot drain His holiness
Yet every dark self-wounding thought Still grieves His heart when we are gone
Is he not the victory?
Lay down your war and let him lead
It breaks his heart when hatred surfaces
When rage explodes in word of fist
It breaks his heart when quiet envy
Grows in a heart no one has missed
He feels the secret self-contempt
The buried shame we dare not name
He sees the quiet self-destruction, the bitter roots beneath our pain
He is not moved from off His throne, His reign is sure, His strength's complete
Yet He is pierced when His own children are crushed by thoughts that drain deceit
What is all this sin to Him? A storm that shreds His family
Both outward wounds and hidden heartaches
The hurt He longs to heal and free
His law was given as our shelter
His wounds were opened as our door
He knows each thought before it forms
And longs to heal its aching core
What is all this sin to Him?
Is He not the victory?
Return, O souls, from flames within From secret wars you'll never win
Is He not the victory?
Fall at His feet and be at peace
